title: ManySig Temporal Generalization and Drift Decay Benchmark
research_question: How does classifier accuracy decay as the temporal gap between training and testing widens, and how does expanding multi-date training coverage mitigate temporal drift?

dataset_provenance.sample_rate_status: REQUIRES VALIDATION (Engineering default inherited from Track-A)

temporal_decay_single_date.description: Train on Day 1; evaluate on Day 2 (+7d), Day 3 (+14d), and Day 4 (+22d) to measure decay over elapsed time.

training_coverage_scaling.description: Quantify accuracy improvement on fixed Day 4 as historical training coverage expands.

leave_one_date_out_cv.description: 4-fold cross-validation across capture dates to measure date-level variance.

leakage_controls: Test date observations never used during training or tree splitting
All 4 folds evaluated on identical feature representations
Evaluated separately on raw (EQ=0) and equalized (EQ=1) bursts
